comments.text: Since I can’t find any comments on this, I thought I should point out that the name “Pipil” is considered pejorative (although it’s still used sometimes for clarity and because it’s better known by the outside world). The etymology is that it is believed to be derived from the word for “child”because the Mexicans thought that they spoke in a childish way (the Mexicans spoke Nahuatl and the locals in El Salvador spoke a related language that appeared childish to the Mexicans), or at least that’s the story as it’s commonly retold. The ethnic group in El Salvador is called “Nahua” (somewhat confusingly nonspecific because the same name is used in Mexico by related ethnicities), and their language is called Nawat (not Nahuatl with an L, which would refer to some related Mexican languages).
